$comment: Single machine-loadable source of truth for division-window (event-anchor) capture sizes used by the Cytokinesis + FtsZPolymerization dual-tap extractor and every Python/MATLAB consumer that needs an authoritative M_ticks/tick_range_from_division value. Do NOT hardcode these numbers anywhere else -- read this file (via scripts/l2_event/division_window_spec.py in Python, or the MATLAB loader in scripts/matlab/division_window_spec.m) instead. PROCESS_CATALOG.yaml's Cytokinesis/FtsZPolymerization M_ticks/seed_window fields are kept in sync with this file by hand and checked for agreement by tests/scripts/test_division_window_spec.py -- if you change a value here, update PROCESS_CATALOG.yaml (and event_registry.yaml's prose) in the SAME commit. See decisions/dec-005-full-simulation-source-hash-binding.md for the source-identity binding this cohort now also requires, and STATUS_DUAL_CYT_WINDOW_FIX.md's 'Corrective pass (2026-09-04, post-Opus-review)' section for the full corrected narrative this file's rationale below summarizes.
schema_v4_changes: Opus re-review implementation fixes (2026-09-09) on top of schema v3's selection_contract preregistration: added formal_estimand/stopping_rule (exact estimand text + non-adaptive stream discipline), max_search_ticks_validation_policy (documents the monotone-minimum -- recorded >= n_ticks, never an exact match against the contract horizon -- fix to scripts.l2_event.launcher.validate_existing_event_window, which previously broke as soon as any caller requested the new 100000 horizon against a legacy 50000-recorded trace), censor_record_required_identity_fields (RIGHT_CENSORED records must bind current dec-005 DNADamage source + mnrnd provider identity to advance the contiguous prefix), and authoritative_operational_root (the dedicated dual_division_cohort_current banking root). No per-process m_ticks/tick_range_from_division/N_seeds value changed.
schema_v3_changes: Added top-level 'selection_contract' (2026-09-08, division-censor-contract preregistration). Does NOT change any per-process m_ticks/tick_range_from_division value (Cytokinesis remains 5000/[-4999,0], FtsZPolymerization remains 200/[-200,0]) and does NOT change N_seeds=50 in PROCESS_CATALOG.yaml. It ONLY preregisters the seed-selection/censoring-horizon contract the Cytokinesis+FtsZPolymerization dual-tap cohort must follow: seed 6 and seed 18 produced no Cytokinesis division-completion signal within the pre-existing per-call max_search_ticks=50000 default (scripts/l2_event/launcher.DEFAULT_MAX_SEARCH_TICKS); seed 18 additionally failed a non-counting 100000-tick diagnostic, and no partial trace files were emitted for either seed under the patched (dec-005-bound) source. Left uncorrected, an uncontrolled 'skip and resample' response to a division-completion failure would silently condition the N=50 cohort on completion, which is exactly the outcome-cherry-picking this contract forbids. See selection_contract below and scripts/l2_event/division_cohort_selector.py for the enforcing implementation.
corrective_note_2026_09_04: Schema version 1 of this file (same day, earlier) attributed the seed-36 conventional-vs-dual span disagreement (3963/3964 inclusive vs 4075/4076 inclusive) to 'run-to-run whole-simulation nondeterminism' and treated the 35-trace M_ticks=4000 survey's max (3971) as corroborating margin evidence. BOTH claims are RETRACTED. Opus review identified the actual cause: the two runs resolved two DIFFERENT DNADamage.m source variants (the live genuine-l22-cytokinesis queue's worktree predates the signed-zero overlay commits; this worktree's karr_bootstrap.m includes them) -- a source-version confound, not stochastic nondeterminism, and not correctable by survivorship-bias reasoning either, because the 35-trace M_ticks=4000 cohort was ALSO produced under the pre-overlay source and is therefore evidence about a DIFFERENT model, not merely a truncated sample of the SAME model. See decisions/dec-005 for the full finding and evidence.

selection_contract.$comment: Applies to the Cytokinesis+FtsZPolymerization dual-tap cohort (see applies_to). This is a SELECTION contract (which seeds count, and in what order) layered on top of, never a replacement for, each process's own m_ticks/tick_range_from_division capture-length contract above. Read via scripts/l2_event/division_window_spec.selection_contract() in Python or scripts/matlab/division_window_selection_contract.m in MATLAB -- both are fail-closed (no defaults) exactly like the per-process m_ticks accessors.
selection_contract.formal_estimand: Cytokinesis process-local behavior conditional on division completion within 100000 ticks under source S, over the first 50 completions of the ascending attempt stream from seed 0.
selection_contract.stopping_rule: Non-adaptive: the ascending attempted-seed stream cannot be truncated early, and required_completed_windows cannot be lowered, based on the observed completion/censoring incidence encountered so far. The stream is walked strictly ascending from candidate_seed_start until exactly required_completed_windows COMPLETED outcomes have been observed in the CONTIGUOUS attempted prefix; a run of censored seeds never justifies stopping early, resampling, or reducing the target -- only a fresh, separately-reviewed preregistration commit may change required_completed_windows or candidate_seed_start, mirroring the per-process m_ticks escalation_policy's 'never same-commit tuning' discipline above.
selection_contract.completion_fraction_role: The realized completed-vs-attempted ratio over the contiguous prefix (scripts.l2_event.division_cohort_selector.CohortAudit.completion_fraction) is reported descriptively -- an upstream-chassis property of how often the patched model reaches division within the horizon -- and is NEVER used as a Cytokinesis process-local gate/threshold, and never justifies changing the stopping rule above.
selection_contract.rationale: Deterministic ascending attempted seeds starting at candidate_seed_start=0; every seed attempted exactly once at the common max_search_ticks=100000 horizon; each attempt atomically records either COMPLETED (paired Cytokinesis/FtsZPolymerization trace files plus this record) or RIGHT_CENSORED (this record only, no trace files -- mutually exclusive by construction). Censored attempts never count toward required_completed_windows and are never omitted from the attempt ledger. The authoritative cohort is the first required_completed_windows=50 COMPLETED windows in ascending seed order; candidate seeds extend beyond 49 until 50 completions exist. This preserves Cytokinesis as a process-local division-conditioned gate (L2.event) without outcome cherry-picking, and separately exposes the patched-model completion/censoring incidence as a descriptive, non-gating upstream-chassis property (not a Cytokinesis process-local verdict).
selection_contract.horizon_vs_existing_traces: max_search_ticks=100000 is the horizon a RIGHT_CENSORED claim must have been attempted at to count as a valid censor record under this contract (a censor attempt at a smaller horizon, e.g. the pre-existing 50000 default, does not prove non-completion over the full 100000-tick horizon and must be re-attempted). It is NOT a retroactive floor on COMPLETED traces: every existing COMPLETED trace pair (seeds 0-5, 17, 34-47 as of the 2026-09-09 Opus re-review) completed well under 50000 ticks and remains valid evidence under this larger horizon without re-extraction -- only a right-censoring CLAIM requires the full 100000-tick attempt, per the escalation/no-invalidation policy this mirrors from the per-process m_ticks escalation_policy above.
selection_contract.max_search_ticks_validation_policy: 2026-09-09 (Opus re-review, horizon-plumbing fix): metadata.max_search_ticks is trace identity (the real search ceiling used at capture time, always recorded and auditable), but for a COMPLETED anchor trace scripts.l2_event.launcher.validate_existing_event_window checks it as a MONOTONE MINIMUM against the process's own n_ticks (recorded >= n_ticks), never an exact match against this selection_contract's max_search_ticks=100000. Rationale: a genuine completion tick is a deterministic property of (seed, DNADamage source S) -- it does not depend on how large a search ceiling was configured when it was captured, so a SMALLER recorded budget (e.g. the legacy 50000 default every currently-banked seed 0-5/17/34-47 trace carries) is neither weaker nor stronger evidence than a larger one, as long as it was at least large enough to have captured the observed completion. This max_search_ticks=100000 value remains authoritative for two OTHER purposes where the distinction matters: (1) building the MATLAB command for a FRESH extraction (scripts.l2_event.launcher.build_matlab_command bakes it in as the actual search budget a new attempt will use), and (2) validating a RIGHT_CENSORED claim (a censor record's OWN recorded max_search_ticks must be >= this value to count -- see the escalation/no-invalidation split in horizon_vs_existing_traces above and censor_record_required_identity_fields below).
selection_contract.censor_record_identity_binding_note: 2026-09-09 (Opus re-review): a RIGHT_CENSORED division_window_attempt.json must carry a dnadamage_source_resolved_sha256 that matches the CURRENT worktree's dec-005-resolved patched DNADamage source hash (scripts.l2_event.launcher.current_genuine_dnadamage_source()['patched_sha256_lf_normalized']), and a mnrnd_provider_sha256 that matches the current genuine mnrnd provider (scripts.l2_event.launcher.current_genuine_mnrnd_provider()['sha256_lf_normalized']) -- a censored claim produced under a DIFFERENT source or provider is not comparable evidence about the CURRENT model (exactly the confound decisions/dec-005 already established for COMPLETED Cytokinesis traces) and must never be allowed to advance the contiguous attempted-seed prefix. scripts.l2_event.division_cohort_selector.audit_cohort reclassifies any censor record failing either binding check the same way it reclassifies a too-small recorded horizon: as an invalid_censor_seeds entry (an unresolved gap, never silently accepted).
selection_contract.authoritative_operational_root_note: The dedicated, homogeneous per_process_traces_v2_event_s{seed:03d}/ banking root (under data/m1_sources/karr_native/ in the main checkout or a worktree) every dual-tap Cytokinesis+FtsZPolymerization extraction should ultimately be consolidated into -- scripts.l2_event.division_cohort_selector.authoritative_karr_native_root() resolves it and default_search_roots() searches it FIRST. It is preferred, never exclusive: a seed's record may still be found (and must still be cross-checked, never first-wins-blindly) in a parallel worker worktree (e.g. bulk-division-a/b/c) that has not yet been consolidated into it.

known_censored_seeds_pending_backfill.seed_6: No completion within max_search_ticks=50000 under the patched (dec-005-bound) source; no partial trace files emitted. A matching 100000-tick diagnostic (bulk-division-a/artifacts/seed6_100k_probe.{log,status}) is CONFIRMED STILL RUNNING as of the 2026-09-09 Opus re-review (status file reads 'RUNNING seed=6 max_search_ticks=100000') -- status remains UNATTEMPTED (in progress, not failed) under this contract until that run either completes or right-censors and a division_window_attempt.json is produced. Do not touch/kill the live process.
known_censored_seeds_pending_backfill.seed_18: No completion within max_search_ticks=50000, AND a reported 100000-tick diagnostic (bulk-division-b/artifacts/seed18_100k_probe.{log,status}) ALSO found no completion -- the preserved MATLAB job log records the exact real extractor error text ('seed 18: division-completion signal did not fire within max_search_ticks=100000 ticks') AND the log's own overlay DNADamage.m (bulk-division-b/tmp/wcm_source_overlay/src/.../DNADamage.m, timestamped to match the run) independently hashes (lf-normalized sha256) to BYTE-IDENTICAL agreement with the current worktree's dec-005-resolved patched source. This is sufficient, mechanically source-bound evidence for a real backfilled RIGHT_CENSORED record -- see docs/phase_f/l2_event/DIVISION_WINDOW_MIGRATION.md for the exact backfill command and verification steps, never fabricated from the plan.md narrative alone.

Cytokinesis.m_ticks_status: PROVISIONAL -- evidence is n=1 under the DNADamage-signed-zero-overlay-active model (see evidence.n below). Not yet corroborated by a second independent seed under the same (patched) source. Do not treat 5000 as settled until at least one more seed's real span is observed under this source.
Cytokinesis.rationale: The prior M_ticks=4000 (reconciled 2026-08-05 from a seed-0 lower bound of 3871 ticks, itself produced under the PRE-overlay DNADamage.m -- see corrective_note above) was never exercised end-to-end against the true onset under the POST-overlay (signed-zero-normalized) DNADamage source until a fresh seed-36 dual-tap run on 2026-09-04, which uses this worktree's overlay-aware karr_bootstrap.m. That run completed a full ~32k-tick trajectory and failed closed: real onset_tick=27918, completion_tick=31993, inclusive onset-to-completion span=4076 ticks -- 76 ticks LARGER than the 4000-tick buffer, so onset_tick necessarily preceded the captured window's tick_start and the extractor correctly refused to emit an incomplete file (capture_dual_anchor_windows' 'onset_tick < tick_start_a' guard in scripts/matlab/extract_dual_division_window.m). This 4076-tick figure is the ONLY real data point available under the currently-active (overlay-patched) DNADamage source -- the 35-trace M_ticks=4000 survey (spans 3637-3971, scripts/l2_event/survey_cytokinesis_onset_span.py) is evidence about a DIFFERENT, pre-overlay model and is NOT used as corroborating evidence for this margin decision (see corrective_note and evidence.known_completed_trace_spans_m4000_cohort_DIFFERENT_SOURCE_NOT_COMPARABLE below). Given n=1 evidence, this preregistration deliberately uses a generous, round margin rather than a tightly-fitted one: 5000 gives a 924-tick (22.7%) margin over the single observed 4076-tick span. This is PROVISIONAL (see m_ticks_status) pending at least one more independent seed's real span under the same (patched) source -- see escalation_policy for what happens if a future seed exceeds 5000.

supersedes.reason: 4000-tick traces remain preserved on disk and are NOT deleted, but are non-authoritative for the M_ticks=5000 cohort for TWO independent reasons: (1) window_loader/launcher.validate_existing_event_window reject them outright on metadata.n_ticks mismatch (4000 != 5000); (2) they were produced under the PRE-overlay DNADamage.m source (decisions/dec-005 full-simulation-source-hash-binding) and are rejected on dnadamage_source_resolved_sha256 mismatch/absence even independent of the n_ticks check. Both must be re-extracted -- under the new M_ticks AND the current DNADamage source -- before counting toward the N=50 Cytokinesis event-window requirement.

evidence.max_observed_span_run: fresh dual-tap equivalence run, 2026-09-04 (pre-preregistration probe), onset_tick=27918 completion_tick=31993, run under this worktree's overlay-aware karr_bootstrap.m (patched DNADamage.m). Independently reproduced byte-for-byte identical onset/completion on the post-preregistration seed-36 re-run recorded in STATUS_DUAL_CYT_WINDOW_FIX.md -- the SAME code path (dual-tap extractor) is reproducible for a given seed; only cross-source-version comparisons showed disagreement.

known_completed_trace_spans_m4000_cohort.note: RETRACTED AS MARGIN EVIDENCE 2026-09-04 (see corrective_note): scripts/l2_event/survey_cytokinesis_onset_span.py output against E:\opencell-worktrees\genuine-l22-cytokinesis's 35 valid M_ticks=4000 traces. These traces were produced under the PRE-overlay (un-patched) DNADamage.m source (verified: that worktree's karr_bootstrap.m is unchanged since commit b8a27a5, before the signed-zero overlay commits d3e91e8/c2174bb/f7d4310 present in THIS worktree) -- a DIFFERENT model than the M_ticks=5000 cohort's overlay-patched source, not merely a differently-sized sample of the same one. Retained here for historical provenance only; do not use these numbers to justify or adjust M_ticks for the overlay-active cohort.

escalation_policy.trigger: Any future observed real onset-to-completion span (INCLUSIVE convention: completion_tick - onset_tick + 1) that equals or exceeds the current m_ticks, for ANY seed under the CURRENT (overlay-patched) DNADamage source.
escalation_policy.formula: new_m_ticks = ceil(observed_span_inclusive * 1.227 / 1000) * 1000  -- i.e. at least a 22.7% margin over the new observed maximum, rounded UP to the next multiple of 1000.
escalation_policy.rule: The new m_ticks MUST be set in a NEW, SEPARATE preregistration commit -- never the same commit that discovered the overrun, and never a same-commit silent retry/tune. Discovering the overrun and preregistering the fix are two distinct, separately-reviewable actions.
escalation_policy.invalidation: Setting a new m_ticks under this policy invalidates ALL traces captured under the PRIOR m_ticks for the purposes of the authoritative cohort -- they are preserved on disk (never deleted) but become non-authoritative, exactly like the M_ticks=4000 -> 5000 transition this file already records, and must be re-extracted under the new m_ticks before counting toward N=50.
escalation_policy.no_tuning_note: This policy exists specifically to prevent the failure mode of nudging m_ticks upward by a small amount to make one seed pass -- the 1.227x-and-round-to-1000 formula is deliberately coarse-grained and margin-generous so that a real re-preregistration is a rare, deliberate, reviewed event, not a routine adjustment.

FtsZPolymerization.note: Unchanged by the 2026-09-04 Cytokinesis window preregistration (or its 2026-09-04 corrective pass). FtsZPolymerization's own window is sized against its own pre-division ring-assembly activity window, not the Cytokinesis onset-to-completion span; it has no analogous overrun evidence and this task's evidence explicitly leaves it at M_ticks=200. Not subject to the DNADamage source-hash-binding requirement independently (its own cohort validation path, ftsz_pre_division_evidence.validate_seed_window, is unchanged by dec-005), though its dual-tap-paired output IS cross-checked against Cytokinesis's dnadamage_source_resolved_sha256 by validate_dual_division_canary.py.
